decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize control elements from both blue and black cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ultimately gain card advantage. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, and Force of Negation, the deck aims to counter key spells and remove threats from the opponent's board. Additionally, cards like Cling to Dust and Fatal Push provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's graveyard and creatures. The deck also includes win condition cards like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly flood the board with aggressive creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine, while also utilizing cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to dig for key cards and fill up the graveyard. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on and overwhelm them with a fast and powerful board presence. The inclusion of cards like Detective's Phoenix and Hardened Academic also provide additional value and synergy with the deck's overall game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Guide of Souls, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to finish off the opponent. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride provide additional support and resilience. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also including utility lands like Arena of Glory and Dalkovan Encampment.

The deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Griselbrand onto the battlefield quickly. It also utilizes cards like Psychic Frog and Quantum Riddler to control the opponent's board while setting up the combo. The inclusion of various disruption spells like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize helps to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through land ramp and utilizing Amulet of Vigor to ensure lands enter untapped. By combining Primeval Titan with cards like Scapeshift and Green Sun's Zenith, the player can quickly assemble a lethal board state. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional utility and the ability to tutor for key cards. The deck aims to ramp up quickly, protect its combo pieces, and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and land synergies.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between creatures like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. Emrakul, the Promised End can be a game-changing finisher, while cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Kozilek's Command provide additional utility and support. The deck also includes various tools like Vexing Bauble and Soul-Guide Lantern for disruption, as well as ramp from Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple. The land base is designed to support the deck's strategy, with key lands like Grove of the Burnwillows and Boseiju, Who Endures.

The deck focuses on casting multiple spells in a single turn to generate mana and card advantage, while also setting up a lethal Grapeshot finish. It utilizes Ral, Monsoon Mage and Hex Magic to generate additional spells and damage, while also utilizing rituals and cantrips to cycle through the deck quickly. The combo potential is further enhanced with Past in Flames allowing for a second cast of all spells in the graveyard. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and finish them off with a massive Grapeshot or overwhelming board presence.

The key principle of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear, using cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to remove any blockers in the way. The deck also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistent card advantage and keep the pressure on. With a focus on cheap spells and efficient creatures, this UR Aggro deck aims to apply constant pressure and win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on controlling the game using a combination of Elemental creatures and key spells. By utilizing cards like Deceit, Solitude, and Subtlety, the player can manage the opponent's board while generating value with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The Elemental tribe synergizes well with cards like Flamebraider and Wistfulness, providing a strong and consistent game plan. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an additional layer of strategy to the deck, making it a versatile and formidable control archetype in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The primary focus of this deck is to use the Amulet of Vigor to create explosive mana ramping opportunities, allowing for quick and powerful plays with cards like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift. By utilizing land tutors like Green Sun's Zenith and Urza's Saga, as well as unique lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and The Mycosynth Gardens, the deck can quickly assemble the necessary pieces for a game-winning combo. Additionally, cards like Arboreal Grazer and Cultivator Colossus help to accelerate the deck's mana development, while Malevolent Rumble provides valuable removal options against opposing threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to accelerate mana production and play powerful lands like Urza's Saga, Boseiju, Who Endures, and Simic Growth Chamber. By using cards like Scapeshift and Primeval Titan, the deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary lands and combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and game-winning plays. The deck also includes some toolbox cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Aftermath Analyst to find specific answers or threats as needed. Overall, the deck aims to quickly ramp up and combo off for a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces of Basking Broodscale, Sowing Mycospawn, and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate massive amounts of mana and create a powerful board presence. Emrakul, the Promised End acts as a game-winning threat while cards like Delighted Halfling and Glaring Fleshraker provide additional utility and disruption. With a mix of ramp, removal, and card selection, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state. The inclusion of cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga help to consistently find key combo pieces and maximize the deck's efficiency.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to cast combo pieces and powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. It utilizes cards like Basking Broodscale and Sowing Mycospawn to generate tokens and gain value from sacrificing them. The deck also includes cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Malevolent Rumble to pump up creatures and control the board. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately leading to a game-winning combo or overwhelming advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly reduce your own life total to increase the power of your Death's Shadows and other creatures. By using cards like Street Wraith, Mishra's Bauble, and Thoughtseize to lower your life, you can bring out powerful threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Nethergoyf early in the game. Fear of Missing Out and Moonshadow provide additional ways to manipulate your life total, while Unholy Heat helps to remove any threats from your opponent. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and counter spells. The deck also includes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The deck aims to control the game by answering threats and forcing the opponent to play on the deck's terms, ultimately grinding out a win through card advantage and strategic decisions.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and then be able to pump up its creatures to deal a large amount of damage to the opponent. This deck aims to win the game through aggressive early game plays and finishing off the opponent with powerful combat tricks and burn spells. The deck relies on cheap and efficient creatures, along with pump spells to push through damage efficiently. The mana base is built to support this aggressive strategy, allowing for consistent plays and access to the deck's key spells.
